Evaluates code, returns the completion value as a string. Empty string for undefined results. Raises CarneError on JS exceptions. 
proc runCodeEx(code: string; sourceURL = "script.js"; argv: seq[string] = @[];
               baseDir = ""): tuple[output: string, code: int] {.
    ...raises: [IOError, CarneError, Exception, KeyError],
    tags: [ReadEnvEffect, TimeEffect, WriteIOEffect, RootEffect], forbids: [].}
Evaluates code, drains async work, returns the completion value ("" for undefined) and the process exit code. Raises CarneError on JS exceptions (eval-time or uncaught async). The event loop is created lazily: pure-sync scripts never pay for it. baseDir seeds relative require("./...") for file-backed runs (see runFileEx).
